games.description: Roll and reroll dice to trigger a hero’s attacks, then defend against a rival’s turn. The two fighters have different tactical options.

games.title: Wilmot’s Warehouse

evidence.location: Lower-right cubby, tall colorful box at the left.

games.summary: Remember where objects are stored through shared stories.
games.description: Players arrange unusual tiles in a warehouse and invent associations to remember their locations. Later, the group tests its collective memory.

games.title: Chess, Checkers & Tic-Tac-Toe

evidence.location: Lower-right cubby, black box in the middle.

games.summary: Three classic abstract games in one set.
games.description: The pictured collection includes chess, checkers, and tic-tac-toe. Choose between different levels of planning and speed.

games.title: No Stress Chess

evidence.location: Lower-right cubby, blue box at the right.

games.summary: Learn chess through guided move cards.
games.description: Cards suggest which piece may move, helping new players learn the board and rules. The guidance can be reduced as players grow comfortable.

games.title: Spyfall

evidence.location: White box leaning on the floor in front of the cubbies.

games.summary: Find the spy without revealing the secret location.
games.description: Most players know where they are; one does not. Ask questions that reveal a spy’s ignorance while giving away as little as possible.

games.title: Cartographers

evidence.location: Upper-left corner of top shelf, gray box above The Fox in the Forest.

games.summary: Draw a map to meet changing royal objectives.
games.description: Each reveal tells you which shape and terrain to draw. Fit them together to score goals over four seasons, sometimes working around monsters.

games.title: Trapwords

evidence.location: Top shelf, purple box beneath Concept.

games.summary: Describe a word while avoiding the other team’s secret traps.
games.description: Opponents secretly choose words they think you will use as clues. Guide your team to the answer without saying any of them.

games.title: The Crew: Family Adventure — Marooned in Paradise

evidence.location: Top shelf, small Crew box directly beneath Codenames.

games.summary: Work together through a family-friendly island mission.
games.description: The crew must coordinate cards to overcome a sequence of challenges. Its cooperative mission structure keeps everyone working toward the same outcome.

games.title: Two Rooms and a Boom

evidence.location: Top shelf, large white box at the left.

games.summary: Discover hidden teams across two separate rooms.
games.description: Players trade information and negotiate while moving hostages between rooms. The final arrangement determines which hidden team succeeds.

games.title: Poetry for Neanderthals

evidence.location: Top shelf, white box behind the stack of cups; NEANDERTHALS is partly visible.

games.summary: Give clues using only one-syllable words.
games.description: Help your teammates guess a target phrase while obeying a caveman-like speaking rule. Slip into a longer word and the opposing team can penalize you.

games.title: Telestrations: Upside Drawn

evidence.location: Top shelf, white-and-yellow box beneath Merry Men.

games.summary: Draw together while one teammate cannot see the picture.
games.description: One player directs a teammate’s pen to recreate a secret prompt. The awkward coordination makes the results part of the fun.

games.title: Wingspan

evidence.location: Middle shelf, pale blue box at right; bird artwork.

games.summary: Attract birds and grow a wildlife engine.
games.description: Play bird cards into habitats to gather food, lay eggs, and chain abilities. Each bird contributes to a developing strategy.

games.title: Wingspan: Oceania Expansion

evidence.location: Middle shelf, yellow-orange box at the left.

games.summary: Add Oceania birds and new options to Wingspan.
games.description: An expansion introducing birds from the region and a different food economy. It builds on the base game’s habitat and bird-card engine.

games.title: You Think You Know Me

games.summary: See how well friends know one another.
games.description: A conversation game about people’s preferences and experiences. The value lies in the stories and surprises behind each answer.
